title: BIOLUMINESCENCE
subtitle: Emission of light by a living organism

pages.caption: Bioluminescence · Wikipedia / Wikimedia Commons (see source for attribution)
pages.text: Bioluminescence is the production of light by an organism as the result of a chemiluminescence reaction. It occurs in a wide variety of organisms, including marine vertebrates and invertebrates, terrestrial arthropods such as fireflies, some fungi, and microorganisms such as some bacteria and dinoflagellates.

pages.caption: Bioluminescence · Wikipedia / Wikimedia Commons (see source for attribution)
pages.text: In some animals, the light is bacteriogenic, produced by symbiotic bacteria such as those from the genus Vibrio; in others, it is autogenic, produced by the animals themselves. Bioluminescence has evolved independently at least 94 times, first emerging in octocorals some 540 million years ago.
